Two states, Maine and Nebraska, allow their electoral votes to be split between candidates by congressional districts. The winner of each congressional district gets one electoral vote for the district. The winner of the statewide vote gets two additional electoral votes.[331][332]

States and EV districts that flipped from Republican to Democratic

  • Georgia
  • Michigan
